name: Bitter and Source Sans 3
summary: A sturdy slab serif over a plain humanist sans, for clear headings that carry across a room.
description: Bitter and Source Sans 3 is a sans serif OPF font scheme for Latin presentations, using Bitter for headings with Source Sans 3 for body text. Bitter's even strokes and square slabs hold up at a distance and on a projector; Source Sans 3 is a plain humanist sans that keeps lists, tables and chart labels quiet. Suits workshops, education, public-sector and operating reviews.
